subject.title: fix(models): clear stale auth cooldowns after early limit resets

question: Should OpenClaw make `models auth clear-cooldown <profile-id>` a supported public recovery contract, including an operator-required safe Gateway restart, rather than choosing a different recovery surface?
rationale: This is a new user-facing CLI and persisted auth-state recovery mode; tests can validate mechanics but cannot select the permanent operator experience or support contract.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped CLI recovery
options.body: Accept the command as the supported escape hatch after a redacted real-flow proof demonstrates persisted-owner clearing, safe restart, and recovered provider selection.

options.title: Use a different recovery surface
options.body: Direct the work toward a Doctor or other maintainer-selected recovery flow if a manually invoked CLI command is not the desired long-term contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped CLI recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the command as the supported escape hatch after a redacted real-flow proof demonstrates persisted-owner clearing, safe restart, and recovered provider selection.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available context for the branch’s intended CLI contract, though current-main feature ownership could not be established from local history.
